description: Analysis plan only (not launched): combines the Phase 3 reduced ZINC sweep (outdir/sweep_zinc_reduced_seeds01 and outdir/sweep_zinc_reduced_seeds23, reproduced-papers-1) with the Phase 4 photonic sweep (outdir/sweep_zinc_photon2_reduced) to compare the two-photon encoding with RRWP, 1-CQRW, 2-QiRW and the RRWP-41 control under one tie rule. Fixed 2026-11-08 before any photonic result. MAE only; wall-clock and GPU memory are not compared across machines.
machine: reproduced-papers-1 (Phase 3 candidates) and the machine named in zinc_photon2_reduced.json
checkpoint_rule: model with the lowest validation MAE over the 200 epochs, evaluated once on the test split
aggregation: mean and sample standard deviation over the four seeds
tie_rule: no winner unless the margin exceeds twice the larger seed standard deviation and a Wilcoxon signed-rank test on seed-averaged per-graph absolute errors gives p < 0.05
selection_rule: none: fixed configurations. The photonic encoding preserves the paper's behaviour if it is not worse than zinc_cqrw1 or zinc_qirw2 under the tie rule.
